headlines.title: Voting Underway in Israel as Netanyahu Faces Battle for Survival
headlines.description: Voting began Tuesday morning across Israel in its first nationwide election since the Oct. 7 attacks of 2023, that is largely viewed as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY from Tel Aviv on how the outcome will impact the United States, gas prices and the future of wars in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Alexander brothers, ex-luxury real estate brokers, sentenced to 30 years in prison for sex trafficking
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors are seeking life sentences for Oren, Alon and Tal Alexander.

headlines.title: White House tempers its tough talk on Canada trade as inflation tops voter concerns
headlines.description: Trump’s combative approach to Canada appears to be softening just days before midterm elections where tariff fueled inflation is a primary concern for voters.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: University of Utah apologizes to Pat McAfee after students mock the ESPN host
headlines.description: The University of Utah apologized on Monday to ESPN’s Pat McAfee after a handful of students mocked him as “corny” and “creepy,” triggering the college football personality during his assignment last week to Salt Lake City.

headlines.title: CDC’s deputy director to depart after four months in the role
headlines.description: Dr. Jennifer Shuford, the CDC’s deputy director, is leaving the agency after less than five months. It’s the latest example of the leadership turnover that has roiled the CDC.

headlines.title: Florida mom arrested after leaving 4 kids home alone during dayslong trip to Vegas
headlines.description: A Florida mom was arrested and charged with child neglect after she left her four kids home alone for nearly three days while she was in Las Vegas, the local sheriff reported Monday.

headlines.title: Alex Pretti’s parents demand DOJ release evidence of fatal ICE shooting
headlines.description: The parents of Alex Pretti, the ICU nurse and U.S. citizen who was killed in Minneapolis said they were “begging” the Justice Department “to do what is right.”

headlines.title: White House tempers its tough talk on Canada trade as inflation tops voter concerns
headlines.description: Trump’s combative approach to Canada appears to be softening just days before midterm elections where tariff fueled inflation is a primary concern for voters.

headlines.title: Motorist led astray by GPS in Georgia stumbles upon house fire and saves sleeping family of 14
headlines.description: A large Georgia family survived flames that completely destroyed their house — thanks to a Good Samaritan who stumbled upon the blaze after his GPS took him a different way home.

headlines.title: Neil Young sues for the second time over Trump’s use of ‘Rockin’ in the Free World’
headlines.description: Rock star Neil Young filed a $10 million lawsuit on Monday over President Donald Trump’s use of his song “Rockin’ in the Free World” at campaign events — the second time the artist has sued over Trump’s use of his music.
